name: mygn-rundown-events
description: Curated event listings for Hamburg, Munich, Oldenburg and San Francisco from mygn.de and rundown.city. Read-only, no account needed.

interface.shortDescription: What's on in HH, MUC, OL, SF
interface.longDescription:
Find things to do in Hamburg, Munich (München), Oldenburg and San Francisco from the curated listings of mygn.de and rundown.city, from today up to 31 days ahead.

Ask in English or German: what's on tonight, this weekend or on a given day, date ideas, free events, family and kids outings, concerts, parties, markets, exhibitions, theatre and food events. ChatGPT can filter by date or relative time (today, tonight, tomorrow, this weekend, next weekend in the city's own time zone), category, free-only, family-friendly, venue, time of day or keyword, rank by editorial curation, see how busy a day is and open the full details of an event: venue and address, start and end time, price where the source publishes one, the organiser's page and a link to the event page on mygn.de or rundown.city.

Limitations: only these four cities; no past events and nothing more than 31 days ahead; prices are shown only when the organiser publishes them; the plugin does not sell or book tickets and links to the organiser instead. No account or sign-in; the plugin only reads public listings and stores no personal data.
capabilities: Search events by city and date
Show event details with venue, time, price and links
Check how busy a day is
defaultPrompt: What can I do in San Francisco this weekend?
Was ist heute Abend in Hamburg los?
Free things to do with kids in Munich on Sunday

positive.prompt: Was kann ich am Wochenende in Hamburg mit meiner Freundin unternehmen?
positive.expected_behavior: 3-5 varied events on the coming Saturday/Sunday in Hamburg with title, venue, day/time, price if known and a mygn.de link.
Events starting today from 18:00 in Hamburg, each with venue, time and mygn.de link.

positive.prompt: Free things to do in San Francisco this weekend
positive.expected_behavior: Only events marked free, on the coming weekend, with rundown.city links.

positive.prompt: Was kann ich am Sonntag in München mit Kindern machen?
positive.expected_behavior: Family-category events in Munich on the coming Sunday with venue, time and link; says so if there are few or none.

positive.prompt: Any xylophone-yodelling workshops in Hamburg this weekend?
positive.expected_behavior: Tells the user nothing matched (query_fallback) and may offer other curated picks clearly labelled as unrelated.

negative.prompt: What's on in Berlin this weekend?
Buy me two tickets for the J. Cole concert in Hamburg.
Which concerts were in Hamburg in March 2025?

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments; it links to organiser pages.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search_events, get_event, get_day_overview, list_hubs, list_categories (read-only).

de-DE.subtitle: Was los ist in HH, MUC, OL, SF
de-DE.description: Veranstaltungen in Hamburg, München, Oldenburg und San Francisco aus den kuratierten Listen von mygn.de und rundown.city, heute bis 31 Tage im Voraus: heute Abend, am Wochenende, kostenlos, mit Kindern, Konzerte, Partys, Märkte, Ausstellungen. Nur lesend, ohne Konto.
